subject: Upcoming Travel Itinerary
body: Dear [Recipient], I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to confirm the details of your upcoming travel itinerary for your business trip to New York next week. Your flight is booked for Monday, June 15th at 9:00 AM, and your hotel reservation has been arranged at the Grand Hotel. Please review the attached itinerary for further details. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact me. Safe travels! Best regards, [Your Name]
